term.value: Lease 11/10/2015; commenced 8/18/2016; original term to 8/31/2026. Tenant exercised the 1st Extension via the 2nd Amendment, so the current term runs to 8/31/2031. Remaining: an 'Extra Period' (fraction of a year to Jan 31) plus the 2nd–5th Extension Periods (the 5th was added by the 2nd Amendment).

optionNotes: Four 5-year renewal options on 6 months' notice, PLUS a 5th Extension Period added by the 2nd Amendment (5/30/2025) at $502,062/yr ($22/SF), on the same notice terms. The 1st Extension (9/1/2026–8/31/2031) was exercised in the 2nd Amendment. There is also an 'Extra Period' (a fraction of a year ending the January 31 after the then-current term expires), at the rate in effect immediately prior.

percentageRent.value: Percentage rent applies (Lease §7.3, §7.4); reported annually. Detailed breakpoint terms to be confirmed against the full 2015 lease.

exclusives.description: No other premises in the SC may contain more than 15,000 SF used for the sale/display of off-price brand-name men's, women's and children's apparel. Exceptions: TJ Maxx, Marshalls (and affiliates); Wal-Mart, Target, JCPenney, Sears, Kohl's (with an Alternate-Rent / termination mechanic if Kohl's opens) and other 50,000+ SF general-merchandise department stores; a full-line sporting goods store; and rights granted to tenants existing as of the lease date.

goDark.value: Per the 2nd Amendment (§6), Section 4.8 was REPLACED: if the Premises are closed for business for 180 consecutive days or more (after the 1st anniversary of the Commencement Date), other than for a Force Majeure Event, Landlord may terminate on 30 days' notice (before Tenant gives notice it will reopen). If Tenant gives a reopen notice it must reopen within 90 days. No continuous-operation covenant otherwise.

assignment.value: No Landlord consent required to assign or sublet the Premises; Landlord consent IS required to assign/sublet more than 25% of the floor area. Tenant may assign/sublet to a Related Party without consent and without giving Landlord a termination right.

camTax.value: CAM: Pro-rata = Ground Floor Area of Premises ÷ Total Gross Leasable Area of the SC; service areas excluded; no admin fee; LL insurance, management/admin/overhead and capital expenditures EXCLUDED; CAP — 1st year ≤ $1.19/SF, thereafter increases ≤ 4%/yr non-cumulative (excl. snow removal and utility-rate increases); audit within 3 years. Taxes: same pro-rata; separately-assessed out-parcels excluded from the denominator; initial estimate $3.73/SF; audit within 3 years.

leaseNotes.label: Exclusive Use
leaseNotes.value: No other premises in the SC > 15,000 SF for off-price brand-name men's/women's/children's apparel. Exceptions: TJ Maxx/Marshalls; Wal-Mart, Target, JCPenney, Sears, Kohl's (Alternate-Rent/termination mechanic if Kohl's opens) and other 50,000+ SF department stores; a full-line sporting-goods store; and pre-existing tenant rights.

leaseNotes.label: Co-tenancy
leaseNotes.value: If fewer than 3 of the named anchors are open for >30 days, Tenant pays Alternate Rent (lesser of 2% of sales or minimum rent); if the failure lasts >365 days, Tenant may terminate on 90 days' notice (or revert to full rent). Per the 2nd Amendment (§4), the named anchors are now King Soopers (~65,000 SF), ULTA (~9,744 SF, replacing Pier 1), Michaels (~32,000 SF), PetSmart (~15,000 SF), and Five Below (~10,000 SF, replacing 24 Hour Fitness). Qualified Replacement must use ≥80% of the replaced space and operate ≥25 stores regionally / 50 nationally. (Original Lease named Pier 1 and 24 Hour Fitness; the COVID exception no longer applies.)

leaseNotes.label: Kickout/Termination (LL)
leaseNotes.value: None

leaseNotes.label: Kickout/Termination (Tenant)
leaseNotes.value: None (co-tenancy termination right is captured under Co-tenancy)

leaseNotes.label: LL Restrictions
leaseNotes.value: The SC may not be used for: non-retail purposes; entertainment uses (bowling, skating, cinema, bar except incidental to a restaurant, nightclub, discotheque, amusement gallery, poolroom, health club except one existing + one small Curves-type ≤3,500 SF not adjacent to the Premises, massage parlor except Massage Envy/therapeutic ≤5,000 SF not contiguous, sports/game facility, off-track betting); pornographic materials (center-wide); used/second-hand goods (except first-class operators like Play It Again Sports ≤8,000 SF aggregate); educational facilities (except Huntington/Sylvan/Kaplan ≤5,000 SF aggregate, or Regency Beauty ≤7,500 SF); restaurants unless ≥150 ft from the Premises (existing ones grandfathered; aggregate ≤20,000 SF). Additional medical/dental ≤5,000 SF aggregate allowed.

leaseNotes.label: Tenant Restrictions
leaseNotes.value: Tenant will not use the Premises in violation of any other tenant's exclusive or prohibited use set forth in Schedule F.

leaseNotes.label: CAM Method
leaseNotes.value: Pro-rata = Ground Floor Area of Premises ÷ Total Gross Leasable Area of the SC (service areas excluded). No admin fee. LL insurance, management/admin/overhead and capital expenditures excluded. CAP: 1st year ≤ $1.19/SF; thereafter increases ≤ 4%/yr non-cumulative (excluding snow removal and utility-rate increases). Audit within 3 years.

leaseNotes.label: Tax Method
leaseNotes.value: Pro-rata (same fraction as CAM). Separately-assessed out-parcels excluded from the denominator. Standard exclusions; no admin fee or cap. Initial estimate $3.73/SF. Tenant not required to pay until 20 days after receiving the bill + supporting documentation. Audit within 3 years.

leaseNotes.label: Insurance Method
leaseNotes.value: Pro-rata (same fraction as CAM); billed with CAM. No admin fee or cap. Audit within 3 years.

leaseNotes.label: Assignment & Sublet
leaseNotes.value: No Landlord consent to assign or sublet the Premises; Landlord consent required to assign/sublet >25% of the floor area. Related-party transfers permitted without consent and without a Landlord termination right.

leaseNotes.label: Alterations
leaseNotes.value: Landlord consent required for alterations to the foundation, canopy, storefront, roof, exterior walls, or anything affecting structural integrity (except storefront changes consistent with the SC's uniform architectural design).

leaseNotes.label: Operating Covenant
leaseNotes.value: One day only (no continuing operating covenant).

leaseNotes.label: Go Dark Option
leaseNotes.value: Per the 2nd Amendment (replacing §4.8): closure for 180 consecutive days or more (after the 1st anniversary), other than for a Force Majeure Event, lets Landlord terminate on 30 days' notice; if Tenant gives a reopen notice it must reopen within 90 days. (Original §4.8 used 60 days.)

leaseNotes.label: Default
leaseNotes.value: Per Lease Article on defaults (to be confirmed against the full 2015 lease). 2nd Amendment §5.4 adds a Forced-Shutdown rent-deferral mechanism (government-mandated closures) with repayment over 12 months from the next Feb 1 / May 1, no interest or late fees.

narrative: Marshalls (Marshalls of MA, Inc., a TJX company) occupies 22,821 SF (Suite 61) at University Hills, Denver under an 11/10/2015 lease that commenced 8/18/2016. Per the 5/30/2025 2nd Amendment, the Tenant exercised its 1st Extension, so the term now runs to 8/31/2031, with four more renewal options ($19–$22/SF) plus an Extra Period; current rent is $387,957/yr ($17/SF). The 2nd Amendment (with KPR now the landlord) also rewrote the co-tenancy — substituting ULTA for Pier 1 and Five Below for 24 Hour Fitness, curing the prior Pier-1 co-tenancy exposure — and replaced the go-dark trigger (60 → 180 days). The tenant holds a 15,000-SF off-price-apparel exclusive and a no-consent assignment right (consent only for >25% of the floor area). NOTE: the on-file workbook tab predates the 2nd Amendment and should be updated; base-lease terms here still need verification against the full 2015 lease.
